modules.title: Introduction to Haruffa da Wasali (Sounds and Vowels)
modules.html:
The Hausa alphabet, vowels (wasali) and consonants (bakandami). This section covers introduction to haruffa da wasali (sounds and vowels).

Key points

  • Wasulan Hausa guda nawa ne a tsaye (Standard vowels) — Biyar.
  • Wanne ne cikin wadannan wasali ne mai tsawo — aa.
  • Wasalin 'i' wasali ne mai . — Fadi.
  • Wanne ne cikin wadannan wasali ne mai tsawo (long vowel) — aa.
  • Wasali nawa ne a cikin kalmar 'Yarinya' — Uku.

Worked examples

Q: Wasulan Hausa guda nawa ne a tsaye (Standard vowels)?
A: Biyar — Standard Hausa has five basic vowels: a, e, i, o, u.

Q: Wanne ne cikin wadannan wasali ne mai tsawo?
A: aa — In Hausa orthography, doubling a vowel (e.g., 'aa') represents a long vowel sound.

examples.q: Wasulan Hausa guda nawa ne a tsaye (Standard vowels)?
Wanne ne cikin wadannan wasali ne mai tsawo?

quiz.q: Wasulan Hausa guda nawa ne a tsaye (Standard vowels)?
quiz.solution: Standard Hausa has five basic vowels: a, e, i, o, u.

quiz.q: Wanne ne cikin wadannan wasali ne mai tsawo?
quiz.solution: In Hausa orthography, doubling a vowel (e.g., 'aa') represents a long vowel sound.

quiz.q: Wasalin 'i' wasali ne mai .
quiz.solution: In phonology, 'i' is classified as 'Wasali mai fadi'.

quiz.q: Wanne ne cikin wadannan wasali ne mai tsawo (long vowel)?
quiz.solution: In standard orthography, double vowels indicate length.

quiz.q: Wasali nawa ne a cikin kalmar 'Yarinya'?
quiz.solution: Y-a-r-i-ny-a has three vowels: a, i, a.

quiz.q: Harshen Hausa haruffa:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Kimanin 25-30.

quiz.q: Menene ake kira da 'Wasali'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Vowel.

quiz.q: Wasali nawa ne akwai a tsarin rubutun Hausa?

quiz.q: Harshen Hausa yana da haruffa nawa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: 25.

quiz.q: Cika wannan: 'Ina _____ zuwa makaranta.'
quiz.solution: 'Ina son' (I want/like) followed by a verb phrase.

quiz.q: Wanene ya rubuta littafin 'Ruwan Bagaja'?
quiz.solution: Dr. Abubakar Imam is the author of 'Ruwan Bagaja'.
